subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ30 across its X-Type X400, XF X250 applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ30 appears in the X-Type and early XF — two distinct applications with different chassis layouts and component arrangements.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, timing chain components as required, complete gasket and seal set, and oil filter housing gasket as standard on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The AJ30 has a known vulnerability to catastrophic oil loss due to poor design of the sump and oil lines, which can cause sudden oil pressure loss and engine failure. The intake manifold geometry electric drive is also known for low reliability, and cracked intake gaskets can cause suction issues. While the engine is generally well-regarded, parts are expensive when replacement is needed.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ30 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ30 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ30 is known for catastrophic oil loss due to sump and line design — we inspect the oil system thoroughly on every rebuild as a priority. The electric drive for intake geometry can also fail, and cracked intake gaskets can cause suction issues. A full rebuild addresses these known vulnerability points alongside the standard component replacement and inspection scope.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, timing chain components, gaskets and seals, oil system inspection and replacement of affected components

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
